secondary_scope: full development reference and two-evaluator predictions; stability and simulations use primary K only

deep_lasso.mechanism: Replace loss-gradient group penalty by prediction-Jacobian RMS group penalty; cross ablate training and scoring
deep_lasso.training: MSE plus Jacobian group penalty, same optimizer, 100 epochs max, patience 12
deep_lasso.score: RMS prediction gradient; no claim that Jacobian saliency itself is new

tabm.mechanism: Shared exact-cardinality straight-through gate across all eight official TabM members
tabm.known_prior: stochastic/continuous gates and straight-through estimators are existing ideas, not claimed inventions

entryprune.mechanism: Official sticky entry maxima versus refreshed environment-gradient means and dispersion-adjusted means
entryprune.environments: three chronological training blocks; simulation uses three fixed row blocks
entryprune.refresh_and_dispersion_shared_change: reset Adam first-layer moments for regenerated candidate columns; both refreshed variants share this change

vtfs.mechanism: Exact K corpus/decoding and pairwise utility ranking loss, compared against same-budget uniform subset search
vtfs.shared_official_components: V7 official variational Transformer encoder and decoder, epsilon=1 retained
vtfs.attribution_check: best neural candidate versus all queried non-neural fallbacks

tuning.score: fixed V7 XGBoost K12 RMSE, fit through 2018-01, ties by smaller parameter
tuning.architecture_hyperparameters: frozen V7 configs; local mechanism comparison, not equally optimized method performance bounds

evaluation.bootstrap_unit: seller, conditional on observed three test months
evaluation.multiplicity: Bonferroni intervals within prespecified primary-K family; pointwise intervals labelled separately
evaluation.simulation_ci: paired Monte Carlo differences within each scene

interpretation.rmse_tolerance: 1% relative increase as an engineering tolerance, not proof of equivalence
interpretation.superiority_requires: paired evidence versus parent AND strong XGBoost-SHAP baseline, with predictive and discovery tradeoffs reported
interpretation.novelty: candidate mechanisms only; limited literature search is not proof of novelty and empirical wins do not create originality
interpretation.unavailable_models: DeepDRK and TabPFN prior failures are retained; no further unsupported FDR or hardware-success claims
